lines.en: I walk along the rock crevice; it is cool.
The blades are taller than I am; I slip through.
The sand burns; I alternate my feet.
One flick of my tail and I turn.
You walk too fast; I cannot keep up.
I follow the roots to the wall.

lines.zh: 湿地的泥粘脚，我甩一甩。
lines.en: Mud sticks to my feet; I shake it off.
I scurry with my belly close to the ground.

lines.zh: 前面有阳光，我去晒一会儿。
lines.en: There is sun ahead; I will bask a while.
I walk inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 我爬过一根倒下的木头。
lines.en: I climb over a fallen log.

lines.zh: 当心脚下，我紧挨着你的鞋。
lines.en: Mind your feet; I am right against your shoe.
I step in the footprints you left.
I lie on the warm stone without moving.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出小小的啾声。
lines.en: A tiny chirp comes from my throat.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔眼睛，保持湿润。
lines.en: I lick my eye to keep it moist.

lines.zh: 太阳偏一点，我就挪一点。
lines.en: As the sun leans, I shift a little.

lines.zh: 我听见虫子在土里翻身。
lines.en: I hear insects turning in the soil.
My tail tip taps softly.

lines.zh: 我把自己盘成一个小圈。
lines.en: I curl into a small circle.
This leaf makes a fine roof.
I open my mouth only to cool down.
I count the ants walking past.

lines.zh: 有人在附近，我抬头看看。
lines.en: Someone is near; I look up.

lines.zh: 有人给我的背上了一点颜色。
lines.en: Someone put a spot of color on my back.

lines.zh: 我蹭了蹭石头，皮要脱了。
lines.en: I rub the stone; my skin is ready to shed.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我能听见自己心跳。
lines.en: When it is quiet, I hear my own heartbeat.
I blink once, then close my eyes again.
Crouch down, and I will dare come closer.

lines.zh: 你的手指比我整只还大。
lines.en: Your finger is bigger than all of me.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是在看你手里的东西。
lines.en: I tilt my head to see what you hold.
Your eyes blink so slowly.
I remember your scent.
Did you call my name?

lines.zh: 仰头看你，我的脖子发酸。
lines.en: Looking up at you makes my neck ache.

lines.zh: 你身上有蜘蛛眼的腥味。
lines.en: You smell of spider eyes.
Do not poke my back with a finger.

lines.zh: 我爬到你鞋面上，可以吗？
lines.en: May I climb onto your shoe?
When you smile, you have so many teeth.
I know the sound of your boots.
You lower your head; I look up at once.

lines.zh: 你的影子够我躲一整天。
lines.en: Your shadow is enough to hide in all day.

lines.zh: 你是给我带蜘蛛眼的那个人吗？
lines.en: Are you the one who brings me spider eyes?

lines.zh: 我趴在你的手背上，凉快。
lines.en: I lie on the back of your hand. It's cool.

lines.zh: 你的袖子里有股青草味。
lines.en: Your sleeve smells of green grass.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看你有没有吃的。
lines.en: I look up to see if you have food.

lines.zh: 你伸手太快，我先缩一下。
lines.en: You reached too fast. I flinch back.

lines.zh: 你坐久了，我就爬到你膝上。
lines.en: Sit long enough and I'll climb onto your knee.
My tail broke; it will grow back.
You stepped on my foot.
I roll over, showing my pale belly.
The pain made me chirp.
I hide in the rock crevice.
My scales are standing up.
Stop poking me with that stick.
I lost half my tail; a poor trade.
I lick the wound; it will heal.
You frightened me, truly.

lines.zh: 蜘蛛眼！你拿的是蜘蛛眼！
lines.en: Spider eye! You are holding a spider eye!

lines.zh: 我闻到腥味，腿自己动了。
lines.en: I smell something raw; my legs move on their own.
Lower it; I cannot reach.
My tongue is already out.
The smell makes my tail quiver.
You wave it; I sway along.
May I have two?
Do not pull it back; I have not bitten yet.
I stretch up, still not tall enough.

lines.zh: 你手心的温度我闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell the warmth of your palm.
I circle around your feet.
After this, I will follow you.
This is my favorite thing.
Stay crouched; I am coming.

lines.zh: 你掌心藏着东西，我看见了。
lines.en: You're hiding something in your palm. I saw it.

lines.zh: 只要一小口，我就跟着你。
lines.en: Just one small bite and I'll follow you.

lines.zh: 这味道，我隔着石头都闻到。
lines.en: I smell that even through the stone.
You nearly flattened me.
Your boot tip flipped me over.
I crawled over the top of your foot.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我尾巴掉了半截。
lines.en: One bump and half my tail came off.
Step back so I can breathe.

lines.zh: 我贴在你裤脚上，甩不掉。
lines.en: I cling to your trouser leg and will not shake off.
Do not nudge me with your foot.
I slipped under your shoelace.
Your weight is a mountain to me.
I squeaked once; did you hear?
I flick my tail quickly.
She is a shade greener than I am.
We will lean together on the warm stone.
The eggs are buried in loose soil; do not dig.
I saved the fattest insect for her.
My throat pouch has swollen.
This season I am a little bolder.
She bit me; not hard.
The little ones will find the sun themselves.

lines.zh: 我们挤着睡在同一条缝里。
lines.en: We sleep pressed together in one crevice.

lines.zh: 我叼起一颗蜘蛛眼就跑。
lines.en: I snatch a spider eye and run.
I will drag this stalk home.
I found the thread you dropped.
This flake of skin will line my nest.
I cannot fit a second one in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我用舌头把虫子卷进来。
lines.en: I curl the insect in with my tongue.
It is shiny; can I eat it?

lines.zh: 我拖着比我还大的叶子。
lines.en: I drag a leaf bigger than myself.
The bone is too heavy; I give up.
I balance the eggshell on my head.
A fly landed on the stone.
Ants in a line; I could eat a row.
Something moves in the grass; an insect.
I see a small spider.
That moth's wing is torn.
The target is small, just my size.
I flatten down; my tail goes still.
It is only three inches away.
My tongue is ready.
This strike will not miss.
I inch forward so it stays calm.
It turned another way.
I hold my breath and stay still.
Closer, just a little closer.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛锁住它的翅膀。
lines.en: My eyes lock onto its wings.
It takes off; I look up.
I miss and tumble headfirst.
It landed on your shoulder.
I hesitated; it got away.
Next time I will be faster.
I bite down and shake it.
The prey is bigger than my mouth.
I pin it with my front claws.
My tail lashes out and misses.
It bit my foot back.
I roll over, still biting.
This strength only breaks the skin.
I bite it and back into the crevice.
Afterward I lick my mouth.
Do not copy me; my bites are gentle.
I poke my head from the crevice.
This wetland is familiar.

lines.zh: 沙地上有我第一串脚印。
lines.en: My first tracks mark the sand.
I hatched out very small.
The sun warmed my back.
Under the jungle, the leaves are thick.
I chose a warm stone.
Insects are plentiful here; I stay.
My pattern matches this place.
I heard your footsteps.

lines.zh: 火一近，我就往湿泥里钻。
lines.en: As fire nears, I dive into wet mud.

lines.zh: 从墙上掉下来，我翻正了。
lines.en: I fell from the wall and righted myself.
The water is deep; my four legs thrash.
A blast; I curl into a ball.
An arrow stabs the dirt beside me.

lines.zh: 光落在我身上，鳞片发麻。
lines.en: Light falls on me; my scales tingle.
Two days without insects; my belly is flat.

lines.zh: 雷声太大，我钻进叶子下。
lines.en: The thunder is huge; I dive under leaves.

lines.zh: 我掉进没有石头的地方。
lines.en: I fell where there is no stone.
